body:
## Purpose
Add parameters for P3 processes

## Content
Six experimental keys for the P3 deposition nucleation target:
- `P3_ice_nucleation_diameter`: the smallest (nucleation) ice diameter
- `P3_cooper_deposition_prefactor`, `P3_cooper_deposition_exponent_coefficient`: the Cooper prefactor and exponent coefficient
- `P3_cooper_deposition_max_concentration`: the concentration ceiling
- `P3_cooper_deposition_temperature_threshold`, `P3_cooper_deposition_ice_supersaturation_threshold`: temperature and ice-supersaturation thresholds below and above which the parameterization is active.

Five keys for ice aggregation:
- `P3_ice_sticking_efficiency_cold`, `P3_ice_sticking_efficiency_warm`: the cold and warm sticking efficiencies
- `P3_ice_sticking_efficiency_T_cold`: the temperature at which the cold value saturates
- `P3_ice_collection_rime_shutoff_start`, `P3_ice_collection_rime_shutoff_end`: the rime mass fractions bounding the linear shutoff of self-collection.

These values come from the P3 fortran implementation, and are not mentioned anywhere in the literature.

Also:
- `P3_mu_smoothing_sharpness`: a smooth slope law's corner sharpness
- `P3_ice_number_adjustment_timescale`: ice number-adjustment timescale.
title: Add P3 ice nucleation, sticking efficiency, slope and number-adjustment keys
